name: codex-url-vault
description: Native local URL library for saving, searching, importing, opening, categorizing, and preserving web references with Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Save, search, open, import, and preserve URLs locally.
interface.longDescription: A native macOS URL library with a SwiftUI app and task-oriented stdio MCP tools. Search saved links and verified preserved text, manage categories, import browser bookmarks, and open selected URLs.
